name: ballasted bed lateral resistance
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 道床对轨枕或轨道横向位移提供的抵抗力。

complete_examples.text: With novelty, the geometric nonlinearity of curved rail beam and mechanical nonlinearity of ballasted bed lateral resistance have been fully considered.
As shown in Fig. 15, the nonlinearity of ballasted bed lateral resistance has little effect on the rail vertical displacement.
